n13df0e6bc8.headline: 'Rage on the Streets': Protests Across Spain Over High Rents
n13df0e6bc8.summary: More than 50 protests were held across Spain on Saturday after the government failed to pass urgent housing legislation in parliament. The demonstrations focused on high rents.
n13df0e6bc8.why: Housing costs shape household spending, mortgage risk and political stability, all of which matter for Spanish banks and the broader economy.

nb90940fa96.headline: Pomina to receive up to VND 1,352 billion in capital support; KAFI plans to raise VND 500 billion through bonds
nb90940fa96.summary: Vinhomes will provide working capital of up to VND 1,352 billion to the Pomina Steel group. KAFI Securities plans to issue VND 500 billion in bonds to restructure debts.
nb90940fa96.why: Vinhomes is a major Vietnamese property developer, and capital support to a steel group signals intra-group financing and restructuring. Investors monitor such deals for corporate balance-sheet effects in Vietnam.

n28fd9164b6.headline: AP Housing Scheme: 3D-Printed Houses for the First Time in the Country
n28fd9164b6.summary: The Andhra Pradesh government is building 3D-printed houses for the first time in India under its housing scheme for the poor. The project is in Tenali constituency, Guntur district.
n28fd9164b6.why: Housing schemes drive construction demand and public spending, and 3D printing is an emerging low-cost building method. Investors in construction and building materials follow such programmes.

nfe3c4fac85.headline: Income in Madre de Dios grew 40%, but human development did not move. Did illegal mining lurk behind it?
nfe3c4fac85.summary: Income in Peru's Madre de Dios region grew 40%, but human development did not move, Gestión reports. Satellite images show faster deforestation linked to illegal mining this year.
nfe3c4fac85.why: Illegal mining affects regional economies, environmental permits and the legal framework governing small-scale gold mining in Peru.
